description: This Java source file defines the ConnectionOpened event class, which represents an event emitted after a network connection has been opened. It includes methods for creating instances, deserializing from JSON, and managing event data specific to connection opening events within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: ConnectionOpened
classes.description: A final class representing an event indicating that a network connection has been opened. It includes static factory methods, JSON serialization/deserialization support, and implements interfaces for connectivity events within the Eclipse Ditto framework.
